title: model-catalog-request payload
description: The query name and v1 contract version are carried once by the common request envelope. The payload carries the provider's own identity for the session when the caller already holds it, so the provider addresses the exact row instead of reverse-resolving the opaque mapping key. Both fields are optional: a caller with no inventory row omits them and the provider resolves the target itself.

provider_session_id.description: The provider's own session identifier, taken from the committed inventory. It is descriptive of the target rather than an addressing key of its own: the cluster still addresses the session by the mapping key in the envelope target.

provider_pid.description: The provider process identifier that makes the session an exact target. One provider session identifier can own several rows, so the identifier alone does not identify which process to ask. Zero or absent means the caller has no row, and the provider resolves the target itself.
